html: † אַדְרַזְדָּא adv. correctly, exactly (according to HaugJBW 1853, 152 f. Scheft 68 f. from Zend derez, make firm, whence Skr. ptcp. pass. dṛḍha, firm, sure, suitable, Zend dereśta, holding firm, Pers. durust, whole, complete, correct; > NöKAT2 617 from אַזְדָּא, q.v.);—Ezr 7:23 יִתְעֲבֵד א׳.
